notes.title: The Lost City Of Malathedra is now live on Steam!
notes.content:
From Ethereal Darkness Interactive, The Lost City of Malathedra is a graphic adventure game heavily inspired by classics such as The Fate Of Atlantis and the Kings Quest series. It is built on EDI's in house engine specifically designed to create games that take advantage of the latest 3D hardware capabilities while retaining a nostalgic feel and supporting modest system specs. Malathedra's advanced engine and classic focus appeals to both modern and retro adventure fans.

Guide Rebecca on a journey to unlock the secrets of her father's obsession; The Lost City of Malathedra. Filled with witty dialogue and interesting puzzles to solve, The Lost City Of Malathedra is a must have for adventure gamers!
